attachments.origin_landmark: lateral third, anterior border (clavicular part); acromion (acromial part, scapula_l); spine of scapula (spinal part, scapula_l)

actions: abducts humerus (all parts, prime mover past ~15deg)
flexes and internally rotates humerus (anterior/clavicular part)
extends and externally rotates humerus (posterior/spinal part)

functional_compartments.name: Anterior (clavicular) segment 1 (most medial)
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: axillary n., anterior branch, proximal fascicle

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band, anterior clavicular fibers

functional_compartments.function_note: Flexion + internal rotation dominant; documented as an independently-recruitable EMG compartment.
functional_compartments.source: Wickham JB, Brown JM (1998) Eur J Appl Physiol 78:6-17; Brown JM et al. (2007) J Electromyogr Kinesiol 17:57-73

functional_compartments.name: Anterior (clavicular) segment 2
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: axillary n., anterior branch, mid fascicle
functional_compartments.source: Wickham JB, Brown JM (1998) Eur J Appl Physiol 78:6-17

functional_compartments.name: Anterior (clavicular) segment 3 (most lateral, borders acromial part)
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: axillary n., anterior branch, distal fascicle
functional_compartments.source: Wickham JB, Brown JM (1998) Eur J Appl Physiol 78:6-17

functional_compartments.name: Middle (acromial) segment 1 -- multipennate about anterior intramuscular septum
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: axillary n., posterior branch, anterior acromial fascicle

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: endplates cluster along the central intramuscular tendon, offset from geometric mid-fascicle due to pennation

functional_compartments.function_note: Pure abduction; the classic multipennate 'central tendon' architecture concentrates PCSA for high abduction torque at the cost of shorter fibers/excursion.
functional_compartments.source: Wickham JB, Brown JM (1998) Eur J Appl Physiol 78:6-17; Gray's Anatomy for Students 4th ed. ch.7 (describes middle deltoid as multipennate around 4 fibrous septa)

functional_compartments.name: Middle (acromial) segment 2 (central)
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: axillary n., posterior branch, central acromial fascicle
functional_compartments.source: Wickham JB, Brown JM (1998) Eur J Appl Physiol 78:6-17

functional_compartments.name: Middle (acromial) segment 3 (posterior multipennate)
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: axillary n., posterior branch, posterior acromial fascicle
functional_compartments.source: Wickham JB, Brown JM (1998) Eur J Appl Physiol 78:6-17

functional_compartments.name: Posterior (spinal) segment
functional_compartments.innervation_branch: axillary n., posterior branch, spinal fascicle

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band, posterior spinal fibers

functional_compartments.function_note: Extension + external rotation dominant; longest, least-pennate deltoid fibers.
functional_compartments.source: Wickham JB, Brown JM (1998) Eur J Appl Physiol 78:6-17

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity musculoskeletal model; Wickham JB, Brown JM (1998) Eur J Appl Physiol 78:6-17; Brown JM et al. (2007) J Electromyogr Kinesiol 17:57-73 (documented ~7-segment neuromuscular partitioning of human deltoid)
